questions.questionText:
Two identical bodies kept at temperatures 800 K and 200 K act as the hot and the cold reservoirs of an ideal heat engine, respectively. Assume that their heat capacity (𝐶) in Joules/K is independent of temperature and that they do not undergo any phase change. Then, the maximum work that can be obtained from the heat engine is 𝑛 \times 𝐶 Joules. What is the value of 𝑛 (in integer)?
